notes: Not applicable, with reasons: alerting and runbook (the tool is local only and has no remote alerting by design; it refuses with an exit code or a banner, per design Observability), a feature flag (the workspace runs only when `cma review` is invoked, and rolling back means reverting the commit), and N+1 queries or indexes (there is no database). Gaps for the owner, none needing code here: (1) the caches (_PARSED, _BARE, _CLASSES) are per process and bounded at 8 entries, and they are never invalidated except by a change of key (the statement's sha, the ruleset id and hash, the profile). If classify ever starts reading firm rules in case_figures, the firm rules hash must join the key. (2) A slow client can hold one handler thread for up to the 30 s handler timeout while its body is read; this is acceptable on loopback, but worth knowing. (3) The R52 tests time the request round trip only, with the case already open, not the first cold load of a 10k-line case. That first load runs without the caches and was not timed here.
